$label: Harbor · calm cool dark, muted signals
$description: Shows the signal-voice knob. Surfaces come from `$ramp` (a cool base tone), the inherited neon state ramp is re-voiced to `muted` via `$signalTone` (hues preserved — err still red, done still green — just calmer), and only the accent + ink are set. On-colours auto-derived. Build with `npm run build:theme` → dist/themes/harbor.css.
